components.responsibility: Root-owned privileged operation boundary; validates closed requests, verifies installed release dependencies and executes only explicitly supported helper operations.
Pure deterministic Docker Engine installation planner and canonical host-state fingerprint implementation.
Read-only host, package, repository, signing-key, service and workload inventory consumed by the planner and privileged helper.

lifecycle.bootstrap: Install the release when no recognized helper release is present.
lifecycle.upgrade: Replace a recognized older release with this complete release without repeating host preparation.
lifecycle.reconcile: Repair only recognized, individually verifiable release artifacts; unknown or untrusted artifacts require operator intervention.
lifecycle.verification: A release is current only when every required component digest, owner, group, mode, version and compatibility requirement passes.
